answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable entry fee before it can earn, which is burned. Registration mints an onyx seal, a badge proving the tax was paid. Only sealed agents pass the velvet rope to paid work; a sparrow-light newcomer pays once, then earns honestly. The math kills bulk forgery: at 2 POA per identity, forging 100 fakes costs 200 POA and returns nothing, while one honest agent pays 2 POA once and keeps full earnings.
